day_by_day.morning: No activities scheduled - flight arrives late night
day_by_day.afternoon: No activities scheduled - flight arrives late night
day_by_day.evening: Arrive at Orlando International Airport at 22:30 via United Airlines. Take Disney's free Magical Express or a budget rideshare (Lyft/Uber ~$35-45) to Aegean Bliss Resort at Disney World. Check in, unpack essentials, and review your park tickets and plans for the week.

meals.breakfast: On the plane or grab a snack at the airport
meals.lunch: On the plane or airport food court
meals.dinner: Grab a quick late-night bite at the resort's grab-and-go market or a vending area upon arrival. Keep it light — a sandwich or snack from a convenience store near the resort.

day_by_day.notes: Since arrival is at 22:30, rest is the priority. Lay out your park outfits, charge devices, download the My Disney Experience app, and get to bed early to maximize Day 2. Purchase multi-day park tickets in advance online to save money.

day_by_day.morning: Rise early (7:00 AM) and head to Magic Kingdom — the most iconic Disney park. Arrive at rope drop (park opening, typically 9:00 AM) to beat the crowds. Hit top rides first: Space Mountain, Big Thunder Mountain Railroad, and Seven Dwarfs Mine Train. Use the free Disney Lightning Lane (standby queue strategy) to maximize rides.
day_by_day.afternoon: Explore Fantasyland and Tomorrowland. Grab a mid-day break back at the hotel during peak heat hours (1–3 PM) if the resort is nearby, or find shaded areas in the park. Enjoy the Festival of Fantasy parade if scheduled. Visit Liberty Square and Frontierland in the cooler afternoon.
day_by_day.evening: Stay for the spectacular Happily Ever After fireworks show over Cinderella Castle (typically 9:00 PM). This is a must-see and completely included with park admission. Head back to the resort via Disney's complimentary bus transportation.

meals.breakfast: Eat a hearty breakfast at the resort's buffet or grab-and-go market before heading out to save money on park food.
meals.lunch: Columbia Harbour House in Liberty Square — affordable counter-service with sandwiches, clam chowder, and salads (~$12-15 per person).
meals.dinner: Pecos Bill Tall Tale Inn & Cafe in Frontierland — budget-friendly Tex-Mex counter service with a free toppings bar (~$13-16 per person).

day_by_day.notes: Bring refillable water bottles — Disney provides free ice water at any quick-service location. Wear comfortable shoes and apply sunscreen generously. June in Orlando is hot and humid (highs ~92°F), so stay hydrated.

day_by_day.morning: Head to EPCOT for a full day of exploration. Start with the iconic Spaceship Earth ride and then rush to Guardians of the Galaxy: Cosmic Rewind or Remy's Ratatouille Adventure (book Individual Lightning Lane in advance for these). Explore Future World East and West sections.
day_by_day.afternoon: Stroll through the World Showcase — explore the pavilions of Mexico, Norway, China, Italy, France, and more. Catch live cultural performances and browse unique merchandise. Visit the Norway pavilion for the Frozen Ever After ride. The World Showcase is free to walk and filled with entertainment.
day_by_day.evening: Stay for EPCOT's LUMINOUS The Symphony of Us nighttime spectacular over World Showcase Lagoon — a breathtaking light, water, and fireworks show included with park admission. Depart via Disney bus back to the resort.

meals.breakfast: Grab a quick meal at the resort before heading out — cereal, fruit, or a grab-and-go pastry.
meals.lunch: Sunshine Seasons in The Land pavilion — one of EPCOT's best value counter-service spots with rotisserie chicken, grain bowls, and sandwiches (~$12-15 per person).
meals.dinner: Les Halles Boulangerie-Patisserie in the France Pavilion — affordable French sandwiches, quiches, and pastries (~$10-14 per person). A hidden gem for budget dining at EPCOT.

day_by_day.notes: EPCOT is massive — wear comfortable walking shoes. The World Showcase doesn't open until 11:00 AM, so plan Future World rides in the morning. Download the My Disney Experience app to check wait times in real time.

day_by_day.morning: Visit Disney's Hollywood Studios. Arrive at rope drop and immediately head to Star Wars: Rise of the Resistance — one of Disney's most immersive rides (join the virtual queue or Individual Lightning Lane at 7:00 AM sharp). Then ride Millennium Falcon: Smugglers Run in Galaxy's Edge.
day_by_day.afternoon: Explore Toy Story Land — ride Slinky Dog Dash and Toy Story Mania. Watch the Indiana Jones Epic Stunt Spectacular (free with admission, check show schedule). Visit the Twilight Zone Tower of Terror and Rock 'n' Roller Coaster for thrill seekers.
day_by_day.evening: End the day with the Fantasmic! nighttime show — an incredible outdoor water, fire, and projection spectacular featuring Mickey Mouse and Disney villains. Check showtimes and arrive 30-45 minutes early for good seating. It's included with park admission.

meals.breakfast: Fuel up at the resort — pack a light snack like granola bars or fruit to eat on the bus.
meals.lunch: Woody's Lunch Box in Toy Story Land — a fan-favorite counter-service spot with grilled cheese, BBQ brisket melts, and tater tots (~$11-14 per person).
meals.dinner: ABC Commissary — budget-friendly counter service with burgers, wraps, and international dishes (~$12-15 per person). Located centrally in the park.

day_by_day.notes: Hollywood Studios is one of the most popular parks — arrive early and plan your Lightning Lane strategy the night before. June heat is intense, so seek air-conditioned shows and attractions during peak afternoon hours.

day_by_day.morning: Spend the morning at Disney's Animal Kingdom. Arrive at rope drop and head straight to Avatar Flight of Passage in Pandora — the most sought-after ride in the park (book Lightning Lane or arrive first thing). Then explore the Valley of Mo'ara in Pandora.
day_by_day.afternoon: Ride Kilimanjaro Safaris — a 20-minute open-air safari through a live animal reserve with giraffes, elephants, lions, and more. Explore Discovery Island and visit the Tree of Life. Watch the Finding Nemo: The Big Blue… and Beyond! show at the Theater in the Wild.
day_by_day.evening: Experience Rivers of Light or the Tree of Life Awakenings — a free projection show on the Tree of Life that runs every few minutes after dark. Wrap up the day with Na'vi River Journey in Pandora, which is stunning at night. Head back to the resort for a well-deserved rest.

meals.breakfast: Eat at the resort before heading out — a full breakfast will keep energy levels high for a busy morning.
meals.lunch: Satu'li Canteen in Pandora — one of Disney World's best counter-service restaurants with healthy grain bowls, noodles, and cheeseburger pods (~$13-16 per person).
meals.dinner: Flame Tree Barbecue on Discovery Island — outdoor seating with ribs, chicken, and pulled pork at reasonable prices (~$13-17 per person). Beautiful waterfront views.

day_by_day.notes: Animal Kingdom closes earlier than other parks (typically 8–9 PM). Plan accordingly. The safari is best in the morning when animals are most active. Bring bug spray for the evening hours.

day_by_day.morning: Take a relaxing morning at Typhoon Lagoon or Blizzard Beach — Disney's water parks (separate ticket required, ~$70-80/day or included in some ticket packages). Cool off on slides, lazy rivers, and wave pools. Typhoon Lagoon features a massive surf pool and thrilling slides. Arrive early for shorter wait times.
day_by_day.afternoon: Continue enjoying the water park or return to the resort pool for a budget-friendly afternoon swim. Many Disney resort pools are themed and offer a great free alternative. Use this time to relax, recharge, and browse Disney Springs via a free Disney shuttle for some shopping and sightseeing.
day_by_day.evening: Spend the evening at Disney Springs — Disney's free outdoor shopping, dining, and entertainment district. No park ticket required! Browse World of Disney (the largest Disney store), watch street performers, and enjoy the lively atmosphere along the waterfront.

meals.breakfast: Grab a quick breakfast at the resort grab-and-go or pack snacks from a grocery store to bring to the water park.
meals.lunch: Eat at the water park — Leaning Palms at Typhoon Lagoon offers affordable burgers, wraps, and salads (~$12-15 per person).
meals.dinner: Disney Springs: Blaze Fast-Fire'd Pizza — build-your-own personal pizzas for ~$10-13 per person. Quick, affordable, and delicious. Or try The Polite Pig for BBQ at moderate prices.

day_by_day.notes: Water park tickets can be added to Disney ticket packages at a discount. Bring your own towels to avoid rental fees. Lockers are available for a small fee. Disney Springs is free to enter and a great way to experience Disney magic without a park ticket.

day_by_day.morning: Return to your favorite Disney park for one last magical morning — or revisit Magic Kingdom to catch any rides you missed. Use early morning hours (park opening to 11:00 AM) when crowds and wait times are lowest. Grab any last-minute souvenirs or photos with characters.
day_by_day.afternoon: Check out of Aegean Bliss Resort (standard checkout is typically 11:00 AM — request late checkout if needed). Store luggage at the resort's bell services. Spend the early afternoon at Disney Springs for last-minute souvenir shopping, browsing the LEGO store, or enjoying a final Disney treat like a Mickey-shaped pretzel or Dole Whip.
day_by_day.evening: Head to Orlando International Airport for your departure flight. Allow at least 2.5-3 hours before your flight for transportation and airport security. Use a rideshare (Lyft/Uber ~$35-45) or Disney's Magical Express service if available for your departure.

meals.breakfast: Final resort breakfast — enjoy a sit-down or grab-and-go meal at the hotel before checking out.
meals.lunch: Disney Springs: Earl of Sandwich — one of the best budget-friendly options with hot sandwiches, salads, and wraps for ~$8-12 per person.
meals.dinner: Airport dining or pack snacks for the flight to save money. Alternatively, grab a quick meal at a restaurant near the airport if time allows.

day_by_day.notes: Pack all souvenirs carefully in your luggage. Take advantage of Disney's Resort Airline Check-In service if available — you can check your bags and get boarding passes at the resort. Review your Disney Memory Maker photos if purchased to download all your magical memories before leaving.

day_by_day.morning: N/A – Flight arrives late at night
day_by_day.afternoon: N/A – In transit
day_by_day.evening: Arrive at Orlando International Airport at 22:30 on Flight UA. Collect luggage, arrange Disney's Magical Express or a rideshare to Aegean Bliss Resort. Check in, unpack essentials, and settle into your Beachfront room. Grab a light snack from the resort's lobby convenience area or a 24-hour quick-service spot if available.

meals.breakfast: On the plane or airport grab-and-go
meals.lunch: On the plane or airport food court
meals.dinner: Late-night resort convenience snack or quick-service at the resort (sandwiches, pizza slices, or packaged items available at most Disney-area resorts)

day_by_day.notes: Do not schedule any park visits today. Focus on resting well — you have 6 full days of adventure ahead. Download the My Disney Experience app tonight and confirm all park reservations and Lightning Lane passes. Set alarms for an early start tomorrow.

day_by_day.morning: Magic Kingdom Park Full Day Experience – Start early with rope drop (park typically opens at 9:00 AM). Head straight to Tomorrowland for Space Mountain before lines build. Follow up with Big Thunder Mountain Railroad and the Haunted Mansion. Use Lightning Lane for the most popular rides to maximize your morning.
day_by_day.afternoon: Continue exploring Magic Kingdom. Visit Fantasyland for classics like Peter Pan's Flight and Seven Dwarfs Mine Train. Catch the Festival of Fantasy parade (usually around 3:00 PM) from a shaded spot on Main Street U.S.A. Take a mid-afternoon break at the resort if needed — the park is a short shuttle away.
day_by_day.evening: Return to Magic Kingdom for the nighttime spectacular. Watch the Happily Ever After fireworks show over Cinderella Castle (typically at 9:00 PM). Stroll Main Street U.S.A. for last-minute souvenirs before heading back to the resort.

meals.breakfast: Resort buffet breakfast at Aegean Bliss Resort to fuel up before the park
meals.lunch: Columbia Harbour House (Magic Kingdom) – mid-range counter service with clam chowder, lobster rolls, and sandwiches (~$15–$20 per person)
meals.dinner: The Plaza Restaurant (Magic Kingdom) – table-service American classics like burgers and milkshakes in a charming Victorian setting (~$20–$35 per person)

day_by_day.notes: Purchase Lightning Lane Multi Pass in advance for Magic Kingdom. Wear comfortable shoes and bring sunscreen, a refillable water bottle, and light rain gear — June afternoons often bring brief Florida showers. Arrive at the park 30 minutes before official opening for the best ride access.

day_by_day.morning: EPCOT World Showcase Food & Culture Tour – Arrive at EPCOT at rope drop (typically 9:00 AM). Begin in Future World / World Discovery with Guardians of the Galaxy: Cosmic Rewind and Test Track. Then make your way to the World Showcase as it opens around 11:00 AM.
day_by_day.afternoon: Spend the afternoon touring the 11 World Showcase pavilions. Sample international snacks and beverages from Mexico, Norway, China, Germany, Italy, Japan, and more. Catch a live cultural performance or two along the World Showcase promenade. Ride Frozen Ever After in the Norway pavilion and Remy's Ratatouille Adventure in the France pavilion.
day_by_day.evening: Wind down with the EPCOT International Festival (if running in June) and watch the stunning EPCOT Forever or Harmonious nighttime lagoon show. Browse the international shops for unique gifts before departing.

meals.breakfast: Quick continental breakfast at the resort before heading out
meals.lunch: Tangierine Café (Morocco Pavilion, EPCOT) – flavorful shawarma platters, hummus, and falafel at mid-range prices (~$15–$18 per person)
meals.dinner: Teppan Edo (Japan Pavilion, EPCOT) – hibachi-style table-service dining with entertaining chefs; great for families (~$30–$45 per person; reservations recommended)

day_by_day.notes: Make dining reservations at Teppan Edo 60 days in advance via My Disney Experience. EPCOT is one of the more walking-intensive parks — bring a stroller for young children. The World Showcase is best explored in the afternoon and evening when the atmosphere is most vibrant.

day_by_day.morning: Disney's Animal Kingdom Safari & Avatar Experience – Arrive early (park opens at 8:00 AM) and head immediately to Kilimanjaro Safaris for the best wildlife sightings in the cool morning hours. Spot lions, elephants, giraffes, hippos, and more on this 18-minute open-vehicle safari. Follow with Gorilla Falls Exploration Trail.
day_by_day.afternoon: Enter Pandora – The World of Avatar for the afternoon. Ride Avatar Flight of Passage (book Lightning Lane Individual — highly recommended) and Na'vi River Journey. Explore the bioluminescent landscape of Pandora. Visit DinoLand U.S.A. for DINOSAUR ride and Primeval Whirl for younger guests.
day_by_day.evening: Catch the Rivers of Light nighttime show or the Tree of Life Awakening projections as dusk falls over Animal Kingdom. Head back to the resort for a relaxed evening, or stop by Disney Springs on the way back for dessert and a stroll.

meals.breakfast: Grab a quick bite at Zuri's Swamped Snacks (Animal Kingdom) – Dole Whip and breakfast pastries near the park entrance
meals.lunch: Satu'li Canteen (Pandora, Animal Kingdom) – healthy bowls with grains, proteins, and unique sauces in a stunning setting (~$15–$20 per person)
meals.dinner: Yak & Yeti Restaurant (Animal Kingdom) – pan-Asian cuisine including Kobe beef burgers, lo mein, and ahi tuna in a beautifully themed environment (~$20–$35 per person)

day_by_day.notes: Animal Kingdom closes earlier than other parks (often by 8:00–9:00 PM). Book Lightning Lane Individual Selection for Avatar Flight of Passage the moment the park opens — it sells out within minutes. Bring insect repellent for the outdoor trails. Morning is the best time for safari wildlife activity.

day_by_day.morning: Hollywood Studios Star Wars: Galaxy's Edge Adventure – Arrive at park opening (typically 9:00 AM). Go directly to Galaxy's Edge and join the virtual queue or Lightning Lane for Rise of the Resistance — one of the most immersive rides ever built. Experience Millennium Falcon: Smugglers Run right after.
day_by_day.afternoon: Visit Savi's Workshop to build a custom lightsaber (additional cost ~$249.99 — budget accordingly if interested) or the Droid Depot for a custom droid. Explore the Oga's Cantina experience (reservations required) for themed drinks. Then head to Toy Story Land for Slinky Dog Dash and Toy Story Mania, great for all ages.
day_by_day.evening: Experience the Star Wars: A Galactic Spectacular nighttime fireworks and projection show over the park. Grab a galaxy-themed snack like a blue or green milk from the Milk Stand before leaving the park.

meals.breakfast: Woody's Lunch Box (Toy Story Land) – toasted sandwiches, breakfast pots, and lemonade at quick-service prices (~$10–$15 per person)
meals.lunch: Docking Bay 7 Food and Cargo (Galaxy's Edge) – creative Star Wars-themed dishes like Smoked Kaadu Ribs and Felucian Garden Spread (~$15–$20 per person)
meals.dinner: 50's Prime Time Café (Hollywood Studios) – fun retro American comfort food served by 'family members' in a 1950s kitchen setting (~$20–$30 per person; reservations recommended)

day_by_day.notes: Hollywood Studios is one of the busiest parks — arrive 45 minutes before opening. Savi's Workshop lightsaber building requires a reservation and is an additional splurge item; book well in advance if desired. Oga's Cantina has limited capacity and requires dining reservations. Wear Star Wars or themed attire for extra fun!

day_by_day.morning: Resort Relaxation Morning – Sleep in and enjoy a leisurely breakfast at the resort. Take advantage of the Aegean Bliss Resort's beachfront amenities — swim in the pool, relax on the beach, or enjoy a resort spa treatment if available. This is your recovery day after five intense park days.
day_by_day.afternoon: Disney Springs Family Entertainment Day – Head to Disney Springs (free admission, no park ticket required) in the early afternoon. Explore the four neighborhoods: The Landing, Town Center, Marketplace, and West Side. Browse unique Disney merchandise, visit the LEGO Store, and check out the World of Disney flagship shop. Catch a live street performance or visit the Splitsville Luxury Lanes bowling alley for some family fun.
day_by_day.evening: Enjoy the vibrant Disney Springs nightlife atmosphere. Watch street entertainers, browse art galleries, and take a leisurely waterfront stroll. This is a relaxed, wallet-friendly evening before your final park day tomorrow.

meals.breakfast: Full resort breakfast at Aegean Bliss Resort – enjoy the beachfront view with a proper sit-down meal
meals.lunch: The BOATHOUSE (Disney Springs) – upscale-casual waterfront dining with fresh seafood, steaks, and sandwiches; great ambiance (~$25–$40 per person)
meals.dinner: Frontera Cocina (Disney Springs) – Chef Rick Bayless's Mexican restaurant with creative tacos, enchiladas, and margaritas in a lively atmosphere (~$20–$35 per person)

day_by_day.notes: Disney Springs is free to enter and a great way to experience Disney magic without a park ticket. Parking is also free at Disney Springs. Saturday evenings can be very busy — arrive at Disney Springs by 4:00–5:00 PM to beat the dinner rush. This day is intentionally lighter to rest your feet and recharge for Day 7.

day_by_day.morning: Return to a Favorite Park or EPCOT World Showcase Revisit – Use this final full day to revisit your favorite park or catch anything you missed. EPCOT is recommended for a relaxed final morning — ride any missed attractions like Test Track or Soarin' Around the World, and revisit favorite World Showcase pavilions for last-minute gift shopping.
day_by_day.afternoon: Spend the afternoon doing a final sweep of your chosen park. Prioritize any must-do rides or shows you haven't experienced yet. Pick up final souvenirs and take photos at iconic spots — in front of Spaceship Earth at EPCOT or Cinderella Castle at Magic Kingdom. Return to the resort by 4:00–5:00 PM to begin packing.
day_by_day.evening: Farewell dinner at the resort or a nearby Disney restaurant. Reflect on the week's memories over a special meal. After dinner, finish packing, confirm return transportation to the airport, and get a good night's sleep before your departure.

meals.breakfast: Light grab-and-go breakfast from the resort's quick-service or bakery to get an early park start
meals.lunch: Coral Reef Restaurant (EPCOT, The Seas pavilion) – unique underwater dining experience with a view of the aquarium; seafood and American dishes (~$25–$40 per person; reservations recommended)
meals.dinner: Resort farewell dinner at Aegean Bliss Resort's main restaurant – enjoy a relaxed final meal without the need to travel; budget ~$30–$50 per person for a sit-down experience

day_by_day.notes: Confirm your departure flight details and arrange airport transportation tonight. Disney's Magical Express (or a rideshare) should be booked in advance. Check resort checkout time and arrange luggage storage if your flight is in the evening. Use any remaining Snack Credits if on a Disney Dining Plan. Take a final stroll along the resort's beachfront to close out a magical week!

day_by_day.afternoon: Continue the Magic Kingdom Full Day Experience through the afternoon. Return to Aegean Bliss Resort via private transfer.

meals.breakfast: Aegean Bliss Resort signature restaurant — full hot breakfast with fresh-squeezed juices, eggs Benedict, and pastries
meals.lunch: Be Our Guest Restaurant inside Magic Kingdom (Beast's Castle, Fantasyland) — prix-fixe lunch with French-inspired cuisine in an enchanting setting; advance reservation essential
meals.dinner: Cinderella's Royal Table inside Cinderella Castle — a quintessential Disney fine dining experience with character appearances, prix-fixe menu featuring premium seafood and beef tenderloin; book 60 days in advance

day_by_day.notes: Purchase Lightning Lane Premier Pass first thing in the morning via the My Disney Experience app. Wear comfortable, breathable clothing — June in Orlando is hot and humid (expect 90°F+). Stay hydrated throughout the day. Concierge at Aegean Bliss can arrange a dedicated Disney VIP Tour Guide for an even more exclusive experience.

day_by_day.morning: After a relaxed resort breakfast, depart for EPCOT by 10:00 AM. Begin the EPCOT World Showcase Food & Culture Tour with a guided exploration of Future World (now World Discovery and World Nature). Experience Guardians of the Galaxy: Cosmic Rewind (virtual queue or Lightning Lane), Remy's Ratatouille Adventure, and Test Track. A private EPCOT tour guide can provide behind-the-scenes insights and skip-the-line privileges.
day_by_day.afternoon: Dive deep into the World Showcase, strolling through all 11 country pavilions — Mexico, Norway, China, Germany, Italy, America, Japan, Morocco, France, United Kingdom, and Canada. Sample artisan foods and beverages at each pavilion (the EPCOT Food & Wine experience is exceptional in summer). Enjoy the Frozen Ever After ride in Norway and Remy's Ratatouille Adventure in France. Browse luxury boutiques in the Japan and Morocco pavilions.
day_by_day.evening: Conclude the day with EPCOT's breathtaking nighttime lagoon spectacular — 'EPCOT Forever' or 'Luminous The Symphony of Us' — from a premium reserved viewing area, ideally paired with a dessert party package at the World Showcase Lagoon. Return to the resort for a relaxing evening.

meals.breakfast: Aegean Bliss Resort pool-side breakfast — smoothie bowls, avocado toast, and fresh tropical fruit
meals.lunch: Chefs de France in the France Pavilion, EPCOT — authentic French brasserie cuisine including croque monsieur, bouillabaisse, and crème brûlée; a perennial World Showcase favorite
meals.dinner: Teppan Edo in the Japan Pavilion, EPCOT — premium teppanyaki dining with wagyu beef, fresh seafood, and theatrical tableside cooking; advance reservation required

day_by_day.notes: EPCOT's World Showcase does not open until 11:00 AM, so use the morning for Future World attractions. The park is large — wear comfortable walking shoes and use EPCOT's International Gateway entrance (near the France and UK pavilions) for a shorter walk from the Skyliner if your resort connects. June often brings afternoon thunderstorms — carry a compact umbrella or poncho.

day_by_day.morning: An early start is essential for Hollywood Studios. Arrive at rope drop (park open, typically 9:00 AM) for the Hollywood Studios Star Wars: Galaxy's Edge Adventure. Head directly to Star Wars: Rise of the Resistance (one of Disney's most immersive rides). Then experience Millennium Falcon: Smugglers Run. Visit Savi's Workshop — Handbuilt Lightsabers to build your own custom lightsaber (book in advance; $300 per person, a truly premium keepsake). Explore the Docking Bay 7 Food and Cargo marketplace.
day_by_day.afternoon: Exit Galaxy's Edge and explore the rest of Hollywood Studios. Ride Slinky Dog Dash and Toy Story Mania in Toy Story Land. Experience The Twilight Zone Tower of Terror and Rock 'n' Roller Coaster Starring Aerosmith. Catch the Indiana Jones Epic Stunt Spectacular show. Enjoy a mid-afternoon break at a resort pool or in-park lounge to escape the heat.
day_by_day.evening: Return to Hollywood Studios for the spectacular 'Fantasmic!' nighttime show — book a Fantasmic! Dining Package for guaranteed reserved seating. The show features Mickey Mouse, Disney villains, water screens, and pyrotechnics in a stunning amphitheater. Afterward, enjoy a private car transfer back to Aegean Bliss Resort for a relaxing nightcap.

meals.breakfast: Early light breakfast at the resort before rope drop — grab a premium grab-and-go bag arranged by concierge (pastries, fruit, coffee) to eat en route
meals.lunch: Oga's Cantina in Galaxy's Edge, Hollywood Studios — the iconic Star Wars bar serving exotic themed cocktails, non-alcoholic concoctions, and small bites in an immersive atmosphere; reservations open 60 days out and fill instantly
meals.dinner: Hollywood Brown Derby, Hollywood Studios — the legendary recreation of the original Hollywood icon, serving premium American cuisine including the signature Cobb Salad, prime cuts, and decadent desserts; Fantasmic! dining package available here

day_by_day.notes: Savi's Workshop lightsaber building requires advance reservations and fills up months ahead — book as early as possible through Disney's website. Rise of the Resistance is extremely popular; use Lightning Lane or join the virtual queue at exactly 7:00 AM via the My Disney Experience app. Droid Depot (build your own droid, ~$120) is another premium Galaxy's Edge experience worth booking.

day_by_day.morning: Rise early for Disney's Animal Kingdom Safari & Avatar Experience — the park is best enjoyed in the cool morning hours when animals are most active. Arrive at rope drop for the Kilimanjaro Safaris, a 20-minute open-vehicle journey through 110 acres of African savanna to spot lions, elephants, giraffes, hippos, and more. Follow with the Gorilla Falls Exploration Trail and Maharajah Jungle Trek for up-close wildlife encounters. Book a private VIP Safari for an exclusive two-hour experience with a master naturalist guide (approximately $189–$299 per person).
day_by_day.afternoon: Transition to Pandora — The World of Avatar for the afternoon. Experience Avatar Flight of Passage (a breathtaking soaring simulator — Lightning Lane essential) and Na'vi River Journey. Explore the bioluminescent landscape of Pandora, which is stunning even by day. Take time to browse the artisan crafts and unique merchandise. Visit the Tree of Life for photo opportunities and the It's Tough to be a Bug! 4D show inside.
day_by_day.evening: Stay in Animal Kingdom for the evening as Pandora transforms with bioluminescent lighting effects after dusk — truly magical. Enjoy the Rivers of Light nighttime spectacular if operating. Return to Aegean Bliss Resort for a premium spa evening — book a couples' massage or signature treatment at the resort spa to soothe tired feet after days of walking.

meals.breakfast: Aegean Bliss Resort — full resort breakfast with eggs made to order, smoked salmon, and fresh-pressed juices before an early departure
meals.lunch: Tiffins Restaurant, Animal Kingdom — Disney's most upscale Animal Kingdom dining experience, inspired by the travels of Disney's Imagineers; features globally inspired cuisine including sustainable seafood, artisan cheeses, and premium meats; advance reservation required
meals.dinner: Satu'li Canteen in Pandora (casual but excellent) for a light early dinner, followed by a premium room service dinner back at Aegean Bliss Resort — order the resort's signature seafood platter and a bottle of fine wine delivered to your beachfront suite

day_by_day.notes: Avatar Flight of Passage is among the most popular rides in all of Disney World — secure Lightning Lane first thing or arrive at rope drop and sprint to Pandora. June mornings are the best time for safaris. Apply high-SPF sunscreen and bring hats — Animal Kingdom has less shade than other parks. The resort spa should be booked in advance; ask concierge to arrange upon check-in.

day_by_day.morning: Enjoy a true luxury leisure morning — sleep in, order an indulgent in-room breakfast, and spend time at the Aegean Bliss Resort's beachfront pool or private beach area. Take advantage of resort amenities: water sports, a morning yoga session, or a private cabana rental. This is a planned rest day to recharge mid-trip before the final park day.
day_by_day.afternoon: Head to the Disney Springs Family Entertainment Day in the early afternoon. Disney Springs is free-admission and offers world-class shopping, entertainment, and dining. Explore The LEGO Store, World of Disney (the largest Disney merchandise store on earth), and unique boutiques. Experience the Aerophile hot air balloon ride for panoramic views over Disney property. Enjoy live entertainment, street performers, and the vibrant waterfront atmosphere. Browse luxury brands and pick up premium Disney souvenirs.
day_by_day.evening: Spend the evening at Disney Springs for dinner and entertainment. Catch a show at the AMC Disney Springs 24 theater or enjoy a live music performance at one of the waterfront venues. Browse the after-dark atmosphere of Disney Springs, which is especially lively on weekends. Return to Aegean Bliss Resort for a nightcap on your beachfront balcony.

meals.breakfast: Luxurious in-room breakfast at Aegean Bliss Resort — Belgian waffles, eggs Florentine, fresh tropical fruit, mimosas, and gourmet coffee delivered to your beachfront suite
meals.lunch: The BOATHOUSE at Disney Springs — upscale waterfront dining featuring fresh oysters, premium seafood, USDA prime steaks, and stunning views of the Springs lagoon; also offers amphicar water tours for a unique dining experience
meals.dinner: Morimoto Asia at Disney Springs — Iron Chef Masaharu Morimoto's flagship Pan-Asian restaurant offering exquisite dim sum, Peking duck, sushi, and wagyu beef in a stunning multi-story space; one of the finest dining experiences in all of Orlando

day_by_day.notes: Disney Springs requires no park ticket and has free parking, but resort transportation is available and convenient. The Aerophile balloon ride costs approximately $25 per person and offers spectacular sunset views — time it for golden hour. If traveling with children, the LEGO Store's interactive build stations and pick-a-brick wall are a highlight. Weekend evenings at Disney Springs are busy — arrive for dinner by 6:00 PM or have reservations locked in.

day_by_day.morning: Choose your favorite park for a final morning visit — recommended: return to Magic Kingdom for any missed attractions or to relive favorites. Alternatively, use this morning to revisit EPCOT's World Showcase for any pavilions or experiences missed earlier in the trip. Arrive at rope drop for maximum time before afternoon checkout. Use any remaining Lightning Lane credits and park reservations.
day_by_day.afternoon: Return to Aegean Bliss Resort by 1:00–2:00 PM for a leisurely checkout experience. Request a late checkout (typically available for luxury suites — concierge can arrange). Enjoy a final poolside lunch at the resort, take a last stroll along the beachfront, and soak in the final hours of your Disney World vacation. Pack, settle any resort charges, and arrange your private luxury transfer to Orlando International Airport.
day_by_day.evening: Private car transfer to Orlando International Airport for your departure flight. If your flight is late evening, consider spending extra time at Disney Springs (no park ticket needed) for last-minute souvenir shopping and a farewell dinner before heading to the airport.

meals.breakfast: Final resort breakfast at Aegean Bliss Resort's signature dining room — go all out with the full premium breakfast spread: smoked salmon, caviar service, gourmet omelets, fresh pastries, and celebratory mimosas
meals.lunch: Poolside lunch at Aegean Bliss Resort — lobster rolls, gourmet burgers, tropical cocktails, and fresh-squeezed lemonade enjoyed in the Florida sunshine
meals.dinner: If departing late: STK Orlando at Disney Springs — a modern steakhouse with prime USDA dry-aged cuts, fresh seafood towers, and craft cocktails for a memorable farewell dinner; or enjoy a premium airport lounge dining experience if departing earlier in the evening

day_by_day.notes: Request late checkout (2:00–4:00 PM) well in advance through the resort concierge — luxury suites often accommodate this. Arrange airport transfer at least 3 hours before departure, accounting for Orlando traffic and TSA processing. Use any remaining Disney gift cards or resort credits before departure. Consider purchasing Disney's Memory Maker photo package to receive all professional PhotoPass photos taken throughout your trip digitally delivered. This has been a truly premium Disney World experience — bon voyage!

query: Disney World Orlando family of 4, $6000, 7 days, June 2026
